capabilities: Break down nested tags into their parent tags
Insert the generated tags in a comment block at the top of the file on save
Replace an existing generated comment block instead of duplicating it
Skip files whose frontmatter contains tag-gen-ignore: true
extras: Only processes tags in the note body; tags in frontmatter are ignored.
problem: Obsidian keeps nested tags hierarchical, so there is no built-in way to derive flat parent tags from them for easier filtering.

relations.evidence: you need to install custom save plugin first

summary: Tag processor that breaks nested tags (a/b/c) into their parent tags and writes them at the top of the file on save.
